en.headline: Customs and Fire Services seize 770 litres of untaxed petrol in Kwai Chung
en.dek: Two mobile illegal petrol stations were uncovered in a public open car park on Stonecutters Island on Monday afternoon; a 26-year-old operator and a 55-year-old driver were arrested.
body: Hong Kong Customs and the Fire Services Department conducted a joint anti-illegal fuel operation in the Kwai Chung area on the afternoon of 24 August. Officers found a private car in a public open car park on Stonecutters Island with plastic storage tanks and refuelling equipment beside it; a man was transferring petrol into the vehicle.

A 26-year-old local man suspected of operating the illegal station and a 55-year-old local man who was refuelling were arrested. A further search of another private car in the same car park uncovered additional plastic tanks and equipment. About 770 litres of untaxed petrol with an estimated market value of HK$25,000 and a dutiable value of about HK$4,700 were seized, together with the vehicles and related tools.

Customs reminded the public not to patronise illegal petrol stations, which lack proper fire safety equipment. Anyone handling, selling or buying untaxed fuel commits an offence under the Dutiable Commodities Ordinance and faces a maximum fine of HK$1 million and two years’ imprisonment; vehicles involved may also be confiscated.

zh.headline: 海關聯同消防葵涌破兩流動非法加油站 檢770公升未完稅汽油
zh.dek: 周一午在昂船洲公眾露天停車場搗破兩個流動非法電油加油站，拘捕26歲操作員及55歲司機，檢獲約770公升未完稅汽油。
body: 香港海關聯同消防處於8月24日下午在葵涌區一帶展開反非法燃油行動。人員於昂船洲一公眾露天停車場發現一輛私家車停泊在車叢中，車旁放置塑料儲存缸及入油工具，一名男子正為該私家車非法轉注汽油。
海關即時拘捕該名26歲本地男操作員及55歲入油私家車本地男司機。人員其後在停車場另一輛私家車內再發現塑料儲存缸及入油工具，共檢獲約770公升未完稅汽油，市值約2.5萬元，應課稅值約4,700元，並扣查涉案車輛及油具。
海關呼籲市民切勿光顧非法加油站，指此類設施欠缺合規防火設備，一旦發生意外後果不堪設想。根據《應課稅品條例》，任何人處理、售賣或購買未完稅燃油即屬違法，最高可判罰款100萬元及監禁2年，涉案車輛亦可被充公。
